timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹114.55 Cr (+69.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹11.33 Cr (+198.9% YoY).
Sejal Glass reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹401.36 Cr and guided for at least 25% revenue growth in FY27.
Chandrakant V. Gogri and Jaya Chandrakant Gogri declared no encumbrance on Sejal Glass Limited’s equity shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Trushti Enterprises LLP, via **Aayush Chh (Designated Partner)**, declared no encumbrance on Sejal Glass Limited’s equity shares by March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Sejal Glass raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to 25-40% and PAT margin guidance to 9-10% following strong Q1FY27 performance with 52.88% YoY revenue growth to ₹117.95 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹138.09 Cr (+32.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹14.28 Cr (+77.8% YoY).

Sejal Glass Limited will hold an earnings call on **October 19, 2026, at 3:30 PM (IST)** for Q2 & H1 FY2026-27 under **Ashwin S. Shetty (VP – Operations & Company Secretary)** and **Chandresh Rambhia (CFO)**.
Sejal Glass released its Q2 FY27 investor presentation showcasing strong revenue growth and ongoing capacity expansion.
Sejal Glass Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q2&H1FY27 on October 19, 2026, at 15:30 IST, available at the company’s website.
